dataset.name: Synthetic MPU6050 fall windows
dataset.caveat: SYNTHETIC. No real fall recordings were used. The generator encodes the mechanics of a fall (free-fall, impact, reorientation, stillness) and the activities that resemble one (sitting heavily, jumping, stumbling), but a model fitted to it has learned simulated motion. Treat as a working detector for the simulator and a correct pipeline for real data — not as a validated clinical device.

metrics.note: Measured on held-out SYNTHETIC data. Not evidence of real-world accuracy.
